SQL:
SELECT
  regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
  COUNT(*) AS "customers.customers_without_vip"
FROM customers AS customers
LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
  ON customers.region_id = regions.id
WHERE
  NOT customers.tags IS NULL
  AND NOT CASE
    WHEN customers.tags IS NULL OR 'vip' IS NULL
    THEN NULL
    ELSE LIST_CONTAINS([__slayer_e FOR __slayer_e IN customers.tags IF __slayer_e IS NOT NULL], 'vip')
  END
GROUP BY
  regions.name
ORDER BY
  "customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21
